line: Crowley's Atu IX: the letter Yod, the Hand, and Virgo, ruled by Mercury; the text gives no path ends for the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter Yod, the hand, and the sign Virgo, ruled by Mercury, with Mercury exalted there.

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Yod, which means the Hand.
this is reflected in the attribution of the card to the sign of Virgo
Yet not only is Virgo ruled by Mercury, but Mercury is exalted therein.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Yod as the Father, who is Wisdom; Crowley adds that the Father is the highest form of Mercury. The Key Scale gives path 20, with no ends in the text.

quotes.quote: The letter Yod is the first letter of the name Tetragrammaton, and this symbolizes the Father, who is Wisdom;
he is the highest form of Mercury, and the Logos, the Creator of all
